_method.source: Harmonic MCP (get_investors + search_companies_natural_language), read-only evidence pass
_method.eu_deals_24m_definition: Count of European companies whose CURRENT funding stage is Seed or Series A, whose last round was announced on/after 2024-10-01, and whose investor list includes the fund (Harmonic faceted count). Systematic undercount: companies the fund seeded that have since graduated to Series B+ drop out of the stage filter; fund-level investor match can also include companies whose in-window round the fund did not join, so examples below are verified against round-level investor lists.
_method.europe_definition: Harmonic's country facet for Europe, which includes Turkey, Russia and Ukraine
_method.examples_note: Every example was verified against the round's own investor list (round type Seed/Series A/pre-seed/early-stage, announced on/after 2024-10-01 unless flagged); 'lead' reflects Harmonic's isLead flag
_method.name_caveats: Harmonic does not split transatlantic franchises (Accel, Index Ventures) into US vs Europe arms; Benchmark's canonical Harmonic name ('Benchmark') is ambiguous so its stored count is unreliable

sequoia-capital.name: Sequoia Capital
sequoia-capital.why: 38 EU seed/A companies in window, led STARK and Pydantic rounds; London office since 2021, Europe is 6.3% of a 3,080-deal book and rising at early stage

andreessen-horowitz.name: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
andreessen-horowitz.why: 34 EU seed/A companies in window with 23 round-verified, leading seeds and As across DE/FR/SE/ES; opened an a16z crypto London office in 2023 but current office status unverified, so presence marked unknown

lightspeed.name: Lightspeed Venture Partners
lightspeed.why: 18 EU seed/A companies in window, 14 round-verified, mostly as lead; London office with dedicated Europe partners

general-catalyst.name: General Catalyst
general-catalyst.why: 32 EU seed/A companies in window, 23 round-verified; London office and La Famiglia merger give it a dedicated European early-stage practice, Europe is 10.2% of its book

accel.name: Accel (US arm)
accel.why: 25 EU seed/A companies in window (21 round-verified, mostly led) under the single Harmonic 'Accel' entity; the London fund IS a dedicated European early-stage practice, but Harmonic cannot split US vs London cheques, so treat as franchise-level evidence

bessemer.name: Bessemer Venture Partners
bessemer.why: Only 6 matches but 3 are led rounds inside the window and BVP opened a London office in 2023; modest volume, real intent

index-ventures.name: Index Ventures (US side)
index-ventures.why: 31 EU seed/A companies in window, 16 round-verified and almost all led; Harmonic treats Index as one London-HQ entity (Europe 33.6% of book), so the 'US side' cannot be isolated - arguably not a US fund at all for this region's purposes

coatue.name: Coatue

examples.round: Series A (seed was Coatue-led 2024-06, just before window)

coatue.why: Crossover/growth player; one EU early-stage relationship (DeepJudge) in window, top stages are B/C/D - shadows European growth rounds, not seed/A

founders-fund.name: Founders Fund

examples.round: Series C (co-lead; early backer via Thiel network)

founders-fund.why: 4 round-verified EU seeds in window plus the STARK relationship; defence/deep-tech skew, mostly participant cheques rather than leads, no EU office

khosla-ventures.name: Khosla Ventures
khosla-ventures.why: 9 matches, ~6 round-verified including led/co-led seeds and As across FR/PL/UK/AT; genuinely writes European early cheques from the US with no EU office

greenoaks.name: Greenoaks
greenoaks.why: Concentrated growth fund (207 deals total, top stages B/C); single EU seed participation in window is a mega-seed, not an early-stage practice

thrive-capital.name: Thrive Capital
thrive-capital.why: Zero EU companies at seed/A in window; its European exposure is growth-stage (top stages B/D/C), shadows late rounds only

kleiner-perkins.name: Kleiner Perkins
kleiner-perkins.why: One real deal (led Juna AI's Berlin seed); the second Harmonic match is junk data. Opportunistic, not a practice

felicis.name: Felicis
felicis.why: 2 in-window deals but both are led Series As plus a led seed at the window edge; trajectory points up - watch rather than exclude

nea.name: NEA
nea.why: Quietly one of the most active US funds at European Series A: 4 led/co-led As in window across UK/DK/FR, enterprise plus biotech, no EU office

benchmark.name: Benchmark
benchmark.why: One observed EU seed participation; Harmonic's 'Benchmark'/'Benchmark Capital' naming is ambiguous so the stored count is unreliable - verified via the Decade Energy round itself

greylock.name: Greylock
greylock.why: Zero EU seed/A companies in window; US-centric (92% North America)

first-round.name: First Round Capital
first-round.why: Zero EU seed/A companies in window; 97% North America by design

crv.name: CRV
crv.why: 2 deals but one is co-leading THEKER's $84.5M Barcelona Series A - opportunistic conviction, not coverage

initialized.name: Initialized Capital
initialized.why: Meets the bar: 4 round-verified in window, 3 as lead, all seed-stage; lower brand tier than the rest of the list but the activity is real

craft-ventures.name: Craft Ventures
craft-ventures.why: Single EU participation in window; 97% North America book

spark-capital.name: Spark Capital
spark-capital.why: 2 round-verified in window, both led, both London; count of 4 includes stale relationships. Likely undercounted (companies it seeded that graduated to B drop from the stage filter) - at the include boundary

usv.name: Union Square Ventures
usv.why: 2 round-verified in window but both are led London Series As (Isembard $50M); count of 5 includes stale relationships. Repeat EU conviction at A - at the include boundary

insight-partners.name: Insight Partners
insight-partners.why: Expected growth-shadow, but the evidence contradicts it: led EU seeds at Runware, dao and Theo plus Passionfroot's Series A in window - Insight is running a real European seed program alongside its growth franchise. If the region is strictly 'early-stage practices', include; note the dual identity

ivp.name: IVP
ivp.why: Zero EU seed/A in window; entry stage is Series B, top stages D/C/F. Opened a London office in 2023 - shadows European growth rounds from there, not early stage

y-combinator.name: Y Combinator
y-combinator.why: 69 EU-headquartered companies at seed/A funded in window (660 EU companies all-time); the mechanism is batch funding in SF rather than a European practice, so treat as a volume signal distinct from the lead-investor funds

base10.name: Base10
base10.why: 5 round-verified in window, 4 led/co-led, with a southern-Europe tilt (both Milan deals); Europe is 13% of its book - a real if under-the-radar EU seed practice

haun-ventures.name: Haun Ventures
haun-ventures.why: Crypto-only mandate, 55 deals total; one EU participation in window - only relevant if the region should capture crypto flow

8vc.name: 8VC
8vc.why: 8 matches, 5+ round-verified in window - consistent participant in UK deep-tech/defence/bio seed and A rounds (led ICOMAT's A just before window); rarely leads in EU

redpoint.name: Redpoint
redpoint.why: 3 round-verified in window, 2 as lead (Gradient Labs, Anam - both London AI); meets the 3+ bar on verified activity despite Europe being under 3% of its book
